question: Can two scalar reader-response coefficients be predicted from the exact source-resolved block8H1 writer vector, completing a non-replay low-rank response program?

authority.v2_invalid_instrument: C has 0/32 aligned pairs; P has 32/32 aligned pairs

novelty: The response-rank screen uses oracle row coefficients. v2 was invalid before scoring because C cannot instantiate the exact writer interface. v3 is the first valid prediction test and retains the fully aligned answer-preserving P family.

frozen_design.population: fresh A1 even rows fit; A1 odd rows held out; all A2 rows transfer; all aligned P rows are answer-preserving controls
frozen_design.writer_vector: sum over two subject-onset destinations of exact donor-minus-base block8H1 cue source terms; direct per-destination reconstruction checked
frozen_design.reader_axes: separate uncentered rank-one SVD axes for block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3 fitted on A1-even
frozen_design.coefficient_model: two independent affine least-squares maps from the scalar A1-even writer-axis coefficient to the two reader-axis coefficients

predictions.pred_a_exact_writer_vector: direct per-destination reconstruction equals fixed-source writer within 1e-4 scored logits on fit, heldout, A2, and P
predictions.pred_b_coefficient_prediction: both coefficient correlations have absolute r>=0.75 heldout and >=0.50 A2
predictions.pred_c_predicted_program_material: predicted program is donorward on >=0.75 rows and retains >=0.60 of full response on heldout and A2
predictions.pred_d_prediction_beats_intercept: predicted recovery exceeds intercept-only by >=0.15 of full response on both splits
predictions.pred_f_price_exact: 38 forwards, 928 examples, 240 unique answer-changing records, four scalars, 512 axis coordinates, zero backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, alignment, writer reconstruction, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.wrong_predictor: oracle rank-one response is material but coefficient prediction fails
terminal_rules.null: coefficients correlate but predicted installation is not material

interpretation_limits: This is a four-scalar affine compiler over fixed empirical axes, not a symbolic attention derivation.
C selectivity remains inherited from the full response program because that family cannot express this exact writer interface.
The two reader axes remain separate live-boundary objects.
